main_body: Tree with a round leafy canopy (rows ~0-29) on a thin brown trunk (rows 30-42) with a dark green ground patch at the base
top_band: Canopy: lighter mid-green clumps at the top (rows ~2-12) shading to darker greens lower down; there is no distinct flat top band separate from a front face, as the canopy is an organic dome
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy dome is lit from above with lighter clumps on top and darker, shadowed greens underneath, and the trunk stands on a ground shadow patch. There is no isometric side face and it is not a flat elevation. Reads as a normal 3/4 organic tree, so it passes the contract.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 4 greens in big smooth blobs with a dark green outline, which is tinted to the material, not black. Next to the references, which have many small leaf clumps, highlight speckle and branches visible through the canopy, it is much flatter. The lobes are large smooth fills with little leaf texture. The trunk is a thin uniform red-brown column with almost no bark grain or roots, and the base patch is a flat dark green fill. Tile density is well below the references.
